mechanism_claims.claim_text: Zn(II)-clavanin C shows a source-reviewed antimicrobial enhancement pattern associated with its distinctive Zn(II) coordination environment and prefolding context; this is mechanistic context, not proof of a direct intracellular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Liposome leakage experiments show clavanins and complexes have limited or average membrane-disrupting ability under the tested conditions, so membrane disruption is not supported as the main target in this paper.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Assay is a model liposome leakage readout and does not by itself identify intracellular antimicrobial targets.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper cites prior pH-dependent clavanin A mechanisms, including membrane disruption at neutral pH and DNA-related activity at acidic pH, as background rather than newly measured mechanism evidence for the clavanin C/D/E complexes.
